description: This PHP class 'ConfigService' manages configuration settings for the OrangeHRM system, including retrieving and setting various system parameters, feature toggles, and security policies.

classes.name: ConfigService
classes.description: Service class for managing system configuration settings, including retrieval, update, and feature toggles within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getConfigDao
methods.description: Returns the ConfigDao instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: setConfigDao
methods.description: Sets the ConfigDao instance.

methods.name: _getConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration value by key.

methods.name: _setConfigValue
methods.description: Sets a configuration value by key.

methods.name: isTimesheetPeriodDefined
methods.description: Checks if the timesheet period has been set.

methods.name: isSupervisorChainSupported
methods.description: Checks if supervisor chain feature is supported.

methods.name: setSupervisorChainSupported
methods.description: Enables or disables supervisor chain support.

methods.name: setShowPimDeprecatedFields
methods.description: Sets the visibility of deprecated PIM fields.

methods.name: showPimDeprecatedFields
methods.description: Checks if deprecated PIM fields are shown.

methods.name: setShowPimSSN
methods.description: Sets the visibility of PIM SSN field.

methods.name: showPimSSN
methods.description: Checks if PIM SSN field is shown.

methods.name: setShowPimSIN
methods.description: Sets the visibility of PIM SIN field.

methods.name: showPimSIN
methods.description: Checks if PIM SIN field is shown.

methods.name: setShowPimTaxExemptions
methods.description: Sets the visibility of PIM tax exemptions.

methods.name: showPimTaxExemptions
methods.description: Checks if PIM tax exemptions are shown.

methods.name: setAdminLocalizationDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Sets the default admin localization language.

methods.name: setAdminLocalizationUseBrowserLanguage
methods.description: Sets whether to use browser language for localization.

methods.name: setAdminLocalizationDefaultDateFormat
methods.description: Sets the default date format for localization.

methods.name: getAdminLocalizationUseBrowserLanguage
methods.description: Gets whether browser language is used for localization.

methods.name: getAdminLocalizationDefaultDateFormat
methods.description: Gets the default date format for localization.

methods.name: getAdminLocalizationDefaultLanguage
methods.description: Gets the default language for localization.

methods.name: getDefaultWorkShiftStartTime
methods.description: Retrieves default work shift start time.

methods.name: setDefaultWorkShiftStartTime
methods.description: Sets default work shift start time.

methods.name: getDefaultWorkShiftEndTime
methods.description: Retrieves default work shift end time.

methods.name: setDefaultWorkShiftEndTime
methods.description: Sets default work shift end time.

methods.name: getDefaultWorkShiftLength
methods.description: Calculates and returns the default work shift length in hours.

methods.name: getAllValues
methods.description: Returns all configuration key-value pairs.

methods.name: getOpenIdProviderAdded
methods.description: Retrieves the OpenID provider added setting.

methods.name: setOpenIdProviderAdded
methods.description: Sets the OpenID provider added setting.

methods.name: getIntegrationsConfigValue
methods.description: Retrieves the open source integrations configuration XML.

methods.name: setIntegrationsConfigValue
methods.description: Sets the open source integrations configuration XML.

methods.name: setInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Sets the instance identifier.

methods.name: getInstanceIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the instance identifier.

methods.name: getSendmailPath
methods.description: Retrieves the sendmail path configuration.

methods.name: getMaxAttachmentSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum allowed attachment size.

methods.name: getAllowedFileTypes
methods.description: Returns the list of allowed file MIME types.

methods.name: getAllowedFileExtensions
methods.description: Returns the list of allowed file extensions.

methods.name: getTimeSheetPeriodConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the timesheet period configuration.

methods.name: setTimeSheetPeriodConfig
methods.description: Sets the timesheet period configuration.

methods.name: setTimeSheetPeriodSetValue
methods.description: Sets whether the timesheet period has been set.

methods.name: getTimesheetTimeFormatConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the timesheet time format configuration.

methods.name: getLDAPSetting
methods.description: Retrieves LDAP settings as an LDAPSetting object.

methods.name: setLDAPSetting
methods.description: Sets LDAP settings from an LDAPSetting object.

methods.name: getDashboardEmployeesOnLeaveTodayShowOnlyAccessibleConfig
methods.description: Checks if only accessible employees on leave today are shown.

methods.name: setDashboardEmployeesOnLeaveTodayShowOnlyAccessibleConfig
methods.description: Sets whether only accessible employees on leave today are shown.

methods.name: showSystemCheckScreen
methods.description: Checks if the system check screen is enabled.

methods.name: setShowSystemCheckScreen
methods.description: Enables or disables the system check screen.

methods.name: getOAuthEncryptionKey
methods.description: Retrieves OAuth encryption key.

methods.name: getOAuthTokenEncryptionKey
methods.description: Retrieves OAuth token encryption key.

methods.name: getOAuthAuthCodeTTL
methods.description: Returns OAuth auth code TTL as DateInterval.

methods.name: getOAuthRefreshTokenTTL
methods.description: Returns OAuth refresh token TTL as DateInterval.

methods.name: getOAuthAccessTokenTTL
methods.description: Returns OAuth access token TTL as DateInterval.
